sentences.zh: 統縣十八，戶二十萬二千二百三十。

河南帶郡。有關官。有郟山。有瀍水。洛陽有漢已來舊都。後魏置司州，東魏改曰洛州。後周置東京六府、洛州總管。開皇元年改六府，置東京尚書省。其年廢東京尚書省。二年廢總管，置河南道行台省。三年廢行台，以洛州刺史領總監。十四年于金墉城別置總監。煬帝即位，廢省。置河南縣，東魏遷鄴，改為宜遷縣。後周複曰河南。大業元年徙入新都。又東魏置洛陽郡、河陰縣。開皇初郡並廢，又析置伊川縣。大業初河陰、伊川二縣併入焉。閿鄉舊曰湖城，開皇十六年改焉。有王澗、全鳩澗、秦山。桃林開皇十六年置。有上陽宮。有淄水。陝後魏置，及置陝州、恆農郡。後周又置崤郡。開皇初郡並廢。大業初州廢，置弘農宮。有常平倉、溫湯。有砥柱。熊耳後周置，有同軌郡。開皇初郡廢。又有後魏崤縣，大業初廢入。有二崤。有天柱山、大頭山、硤石山、谷水。澠池後周置河南郡，大象中廢。新安後周置中州及東垣縣，州尋廢。開皇十六年置穀州，仁壽四年州廢，又廢新安入東垣。大業初改名新安。有冶官。有騩山、強山、缺門山、孝水、澗水、金谷水。偃師舊廢，開皇十六年置。有關官。有河陽倉。有都尉府。有首陽山、酈山、乾脯山。鞏後齊廢，開皇十六年複。有興洛倉。有九山，有天陵山、緱山、東首陽山。宜陽後魏置宜陽郡，東魏置陽州，後周改曰熊州。又複後魏置南澠池縣。後周改曰昌洛。開皇初郡廢。十八年改昌洛曰洛水。大業初廢熊州，省洛水入宜陽。又東魏置金門郡，後周廢。有福昌宮、金門山、女幾山、太陰山、嶕嶢山。壽安後魏置縣曰甘棠，仁壽四年改焉。有顯仁宮。有慈澗。陸渾東魏置伊川郡，領南陸渾縣。開皇初廢郡，改縣曰伏流。大業初改曰陸渾。又有東魏北荊州，後周改曰和州。開皇初又改曰伊州。大業初州廢。又有東魏東亭縣，尋廢。有方山、三塗山、孤山、陽山、王母澗。伊闕舊曰新城，東魏置新城郡。開皇初郡廢。十八年縣改名焉。有伊闕山。興泰大業初置。有鹿歸山、石墨山、鐘山。緱氏舊廢，東魏置。開皇十六年廢，大業初又置。有緱氏山、轘轅山、景山。崇陽後魏置，曰潁陽。東魏分置堙陽，後周廢潁陽入。開皇六年改曰武林。十八年改曰輪氏，大業元年改曰嵩陽。又有東魏中川郡，後周廢。有嵩高山、少室山、潁水。陽城後魏置陽城郡，開皇初廢。十六年置嵩州，仁壽四年廢。又後魏置康城縣，仁壽四年廢入焉。有箕山、偃月山、荊山、禹山、崤山。滎陽郡舊鄭州。

translations.literal: Henan carried a commandery. There were barrier offices. It had Jia Mountain and the Chan River. Luoyang had been an old capital since Han. Later Wei established Sizhou; Eastern Wei changed it to Luozhou. Later Zhou established the six offices of the Eastern Capital and the area commandant of Luozhou. In Kaihuang year one, the six offices were changed and the Department of State Affairs of the Eastern Capital was established. That year the Department of State Affairs of the Eastern Capital was abolished. In year two the area commandant was abolished and the Henan Circuit Branch Secretariat was established. In year three the branch secretariat was abolished, and the inspector of Luozhou was made to supervise the chief inspector. In year fourteen a separate chief inspector was established at Jinyong City. When Emperor Yang ascended the throne, the office was abolished. Henan County was established; when Eastern Wei moved to Ye, it was changed to Yiqian County. Later Zhou again called it Henan. In Daye year one it was moved into the new capital. Eastern Wei also established Luoyang Commandery and Heyin County. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commanderies were all abolished, and Yichuan County was separately established. At the beginning of Daye, Heyin and Yichuan counties were merged into it. Wenxiang was formerly called Hucheng and was changed in Kaihuang year sixteen. It had Wang Ravine, Quanjiu Ravine, and Qin Mountain. Taolin was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. It had Shangyang Palace and the Zi River. Shan was established by Later Wei, together with Shanzhou and Hengnong Commandery. Later Zhou also established Xiao Commandery. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commanderies were all abolished. At the beginning of Daye the province was abolished and Hongnong Palace was established. It had a constant-level granary, warm springs, and Dizhu. Xiong'er was established by Later Zhou and had Tonggui Commandery. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. It also had Later Wei's Xiao County, which at the beginning of Daye was abolished into it. It had the two Xiao passes, Tianzhu Mountain, Datou Mountain, Xiashi Mountain, and the Gu River. Mianchi had Henan Commandery established by Later Zhou, which was abolished during Daxiang. Xin'an had Zhongzhou and Dongyuan County established by Later Zhou; the province was soon abolished. In Kaihuang year sixteen Guzhou was established; in Renshou year four the province was abolished, and Xin'an was also abolished into Dongyuan. At the beginning of Daye the name was changed to Xin'an. It had smelting offices, Wei Mountain, Qiang Mountain, Quemen Mountain, the Xiao River, the Jian River, and Jingu River. Yanshi had long been abolished and was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. It had barrier offices, Heyang Granary, a commandant's office, Shouyang Mountain, Li Mountain, and Ganfu Mountain. Gong was abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year sixteen. It had Xingluo Granary. It had Nine Mountains, Tianling Mountain, Gou Mountain, and Eastern Shouyang Mountain. Yiyang had Yiyang Commandery established by Later Wei; Eastern Wei established Yangzhou; Later Zhou changed it to Xiongzhou. Later Wei's Nanmianchi County was also restored. Later Zhou changed it to Changluo. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. In year eighteen Changluo was changed to Luoshui. At the beginning of Daye, Xiongzhou was abolished and Luoshui was merged into Yiyang. Eastern Wei also established Jinmen Commandery, which Later Zhou abolished. It had Fuchang Palace, Jinmen Mountain, Nuji Mountain, Taiyin Mountain, and Jiaoyao Mountain. Shou'an was established by Later Wei as Gantang County; in Renshou year four it was changed. It had Xianren Palace and Ci Ravine. Luhun had Yichuan Commandery established by Eastern Wei, governing Nanluhun County. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished and the county was changed to Fuliu. At the beginning of Daye it was changed to Luhun. It also had Northern Jingzhou, established by Eastern Wei; Later Zhou changed it to Hezhou. At the beginning of Kaihuang it was again changed to Yizhou. At the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. It also had Dongting County, established by Eastern Wei and soon abolished. It had Fang Mountain, Santu Mountain, Gu Mountain, Yang Mountain, and Wangmu Ravine. Yique was formerly called Xincheng; Eastern Wei established Xincheng Commandery. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. In year eighteen the county's name was changed. It had Yique Mountain. Xingtai was established at the beginning of Daye. It had Lugui Mountain, Shimo Mountain, and Zhong Mountain. Goushi had long been abolished and was established by Eastern Wei. In Kaihuang year sixteen it was abolished, and at the beginning of Daye it was established again. It had Goushi Mountain, Huanyuan Mountain, and Jing Mountain. Chongyang was established by Later Wei and called Yingyang. Eastern Wei separately established Yinyang, and Later Zhou abolished Yingyang into it. In Kaihuang year six it was changed to Wulin; in year eighteen it was changed to Lunshi; in Daye year one it was changed to Songyang. It also had Zhongchuan Commandery of Eastern Wei, which Later Zhou abolished. It had Songgao Mountain, Shaoshi Mountain, and the Ying River. Yangcheng had Yangcheng Commandery established by Later Wei, which was abolished at the beginning of Kaihuang. In year sixteen Songzhou was established; in Renshou year four it was abolished. Later Wei had also established Kangcheng County, which in Renshou year four was abolished into it. It had Ji Mountain, Yanyue Mountain, Jing Mountain, Yu Mountain, and Xiao Mountain. Xingyang Commandery was formerly Zhengzhou.

sentences.zh: 統縣十一，戶十六萬九百六十四。

管城舊曰中牟，東魏置廣武郡。開皇初郡廢，改中牟曰內牟。十六年析置管城。十八年改內牟曰圃田入焉。後魏置曲梁縣，後齊廢，有鄭水。汜水舊曰成皋，即武牢也。後魏置東中府，東魏置北豫州，後周置滎州。開皇初曰鄭州，十八年改成皋曰汜水。大業初置武牢都尉府。有周山、天陵山。滎澤開皇四年置，曰廣武。仁壽元年改名焉。原武開皇十六年置。陽武圃田開皇十六年置，曰郟城。大業初改焉。浚儀東魏置梁州、陳留郡，後齊廢開封郡入，後周改曰汴州。開皇初郡廢，大業初州廢。有關官。有通濟渠、蔡水。酸棗後齊廢，開皇六年複。有關官。新鄭後魏廢，開皇十六年複，大業初並宛陵縣入焉。有關官。有大騩山。滎陽舊置滎陽郡。後齊省卷、京二縣入，改曰成皋郡。開皇初郡廢。有京索水、梧桐澗。開封東魏置郡，後齊廢。梁郡開皇十六年置宋州。

translations.literal: Guancheng was formerly called Zhongmou. Eastern Wei established Guangwu Commandery. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished and Zhongmou was changed to Neimou. In year sixteen Guancheng was separately established. In year eighteen Neimou was changed to Putian and merged into it. Later Wei established Quliang County, which Later Qi abolished. It had the Zheng River. Sishui was formerly called Chenggao, which was Wulao. Later Wei established the Eastern Central Office; Eastern Wei established Northern Yuzhou; Later Zhou established Xingzhou. At the beginning of Kaihuang it was called Zhengzhou. In year eighteen Chenggao was changed to Sishui. At the beginning of Daye, the Wulao commandant's office was established. It had Zhou Mountain and Tianling Mountain. Xingze was established in Kaihuang year four and called Guangwu. In Renshou year one its name was changed. Yuanwu was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. Yangwu and Putian were established in Kaihuang year sixteen; Putian was called Jiacheng, and at the beginning of Daye its name was changed. Junyi had Liangzhou and Chenliu Commandery established by Eastern Wei; Later Qi abolished Kaifeng Commandery into it; Later Zhou changed it to Bianzhou. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. It had barrier offices, the Tongji Canal, and the Cai River. Suanzao was abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year six. It had barrier offices. Xinzheng was abolished by Later Wei and restored in Kaihuang year sixteen; at the beginning of Daye Wanling County was merged into it. It had barrier offices and Dawei Mountain. Xingyang formerly had Xingyang Commandery. Later Qi abolished Juan and Jing counties into it and changed it to Chenggao Commandery. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. It had Jingsuo River and Wutong Ravine. Kaifeng had a commandery established by Eastern Wei, which Later Qi abolished. Liang Commandery had Songzhou established in Kaihuang year sixteen.

sentences.zh: 統縣十三，戶十五萬五千四百七十七。

宋城舊曰睢陽，置梁郡。開皇初郡廢，十八年縣改名焉。大業初又置郡。又梁置北新安郡，尋廢。雍丘後魏置陽夏郡。開皇初郡廢，十六年置杞州。大業初州廢。襄邑後齊廢，開皇十六年複。甯陵後齊廢，開皇六年複。虞城後魏曰蕭，後齊廢。開皇十六年置，改名焉。又後魏置沛郡，後齊廢。谷熟後魏廢，開皇十六年複。陳留後魏廢，開皇六年複。十六年析置新裡縣，大業初廢入焉。又有小黃縣，後齊廢入。有睢水、渙水。下邑後齊廢巳吾縣入焉。考城後魏曰考陽，置北梁郡。後齊郡縣並廢，為城安縣。開皇十八年以重名，改曰考城。楚丘後魏曰巳氏，置北譙郡。後齊郡縣並廢。開皇四年又置巳氏，六年改曰楚丘。碭山后魏置，曰安陽。開皇十八年改名焉。有碭山、魚山。圉城舊曰圉，後齊廢，開皇六年複置，曰圉城。有谷水。柘城舊曰柘，久廢。開皇十六年置，曰柘城。譙郡後魏置南充州。

translations.literal: Songcheng was formerly called Suiyang, where Liang Commandery was established. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and in year eighteen the county name was changed. At the beginning of Daye the commandery was again established. Liang also established Northern Xin'an Commandery, which was soon abolished. Yongqiu had Yangxia Commandery established by Later Wei. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished; in year sixteen Qizhou was established. At the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. Xiangyi was abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year sixteen. Ningling was abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year six. Yucheng was called Xiao under Later Wei and was abolished by Later Qi. In Kaihuang year sixteen it was established and its name was changed. Later Wei had also established Pei Commandery, which Later Qi abolished. Gushu was abolished by Later Wei and restored in Kaihuang year sixteen. Chenliu was abolished by Later Wei and restored in Kaihuang year six. In year sixteen Xinli County was separately established, and at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Chenliu. It also had Xiaohuang County, which Later Qi abolished into it. It had the Sui River and Huan River. Xiayi had Siwu County abolished into it by Later Qi. Kaocheng was called Kaoyang under Later Wei, and Northern Liang Commandery was established there. Later Qi abolished both the commandery and county and made it Cheng'an County. In Kaihuang year eighteen, because the name was duplicated, it was changed to Kaocheng. Chuqiu was called Sishi under Later Wei, and Northern Qiao Commandery was established there. Later Qi abolished both commandery and county. In Kaihuang year four Sishi was again established, and in year six it was changed to Chuqiu. Dangshan was established by Later Wei and called Anyang. In Kaihuang year eighteen its name was changed. It had Dang Mountain and Yu Mountain. Yucheng was formerly called Yu; Later Qi abolished it, and in Kaihuang year six it was restored as Yucheng. It had the Gu River. Zhecheng was formerly called Zhe and had long been abolished. In Kaihuang year sixteen it was established as Zhecheng. Qiao Commandery had Southern Chongzhou established by Later Wei.

At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished; in year sixteen Qizhou was established. At the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. Xiangyi was abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year sixteen. Ningling was abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year six. Yucheng was called Xiao under Later Wei and was abolished by Later Qi. In Kaihuang year sixteen it was established and its name was changed. Later Wei had also established Pei Commandery, which Later Qi abolished. Gushu was abolished by Later Wei and restored in Kaihuang year sixteen. Chenliu was abolished by Later Wei and restored in Kaihuang year six. In year sixteen Xinli County was separately established, and at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Chenliu. It also had Xiaohuang County, which Later Qi abolished into it. It had the Sui River and Huan River. Xiayi had Siwu County abolished into it by Later Qi. Kaocheng was called Kaoyang under Later Wei, and Northern Liang Commandery was established there. Later Qi abolished both the commandery and county and made it Cheng'an County. In Kaihuang year eighteen, because the name was duplicated, it was changed to Kaocheng. Chuqiu was called Sishi under Later Wei, and Northern Qiao Commandery was established there. Later Qi abolished both commandery and county. In Kaihuang year four Sishi was again established, and in year six it was changed to Chuqiu. Dangshan was established by Later Wei and called Anyang. In Kaihuang year eighteen its name was changed. It had Dang Mountain and Yu Mountain. Yucheng was formerly called Yu; Later Qi abolished it, and in Kaihuang year six it was restored as Yucheng. It had the Gu River. Zhecheng was formerly called Zhe and had long been abolished. In Kaihuang year sixteen it was established as Zhecheng. Qiao Commandery had Southern Chongzhou established by Later Wei.

sentences.zh: 統縣六，戶七萬四千八百一十七。

譙舊曰小黃，置陳留郡。開皇初郡廢，十六年分置梅城縣。大業三年，改小黃為譙縣，並梅城入焉。酂舊廢，開皇十六年複。舊有馬頭郡，後魏又置下邑縣，後齊並廢。城父宋置，曰浚儀。開皇十八年改焉。谷陽後齊省，開皇六年複。山桑後魏置渦州、渦陽縣，又置譙郡。梁改渦州曰西徐州。東魏改曰譙州。開皇初郡廢，十六年改渦陽為肥水。大業初州廢，改縣曰山桑。又梁置北新安郡，東魏改置蒙郡。後齊廢郡，置蒙縣，後又置郡。開皇初郡廢。又梁置陽夏郡，東魏廢。臨渙後魏置臨渙郡，又別置丹城縣。東魏析置白椫縣，後齊郡廢。開皇元年丹城省，大業初白椫又省，併入焉。有嵇山、龍岡。濟陰郡後魏置西兗州，後周改曰曹州。

translations.literal: Qiao was formerly called Xiaohuang, where Chenliu Commandery was established. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and in year sixteen Meicheng County was separately established. In Daye year three Xiaohuang was changed to Qiao County, and Meicheng was merged into it. Zan had long been abolished and was restored in Kaihuang year sixteen. It formerly had Matou Commandery; Later Wei also established Xiayi County; Later Qi abolished both. Chengfu was established by Song and called Junyi. In Kaihuang year eighteen it was changed. Guyang was abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year six. Shansang had Guozhou and Guoyang County established by Later Wei, and Qiao Commandery was also established there. Liang changed Guozhou to Western Xuzhou. Eastern Wei changed it to Qiaozhou. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished; in year sixteen Guoyang was changed to Feishui. At the beginning of Daye the province was abolished and the county was changed to Shansang. Liang also established Northern Xin'an Commandery; Eastern Wei changed it to Meng Commandery. Later Qi abolished the commandery and established Meng County, and later again established the commandery. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. Liang also established Yangxia Commandery, which Eastern Wei abolished. Linhuan had Linhuan Commandery established by Later Wei, and Dancheng County was separately established. Eastern Wei divided off and established Baishan County; Later Qi abolished the commandery. In Kaihuang year one Dancheng was abolished, and at the beginning of Daye Baishan was also abolished and merged into it. It had Ji Mountain and Long Ridge. Jiyin Commandery had Western Yanzhou established by Later Wei; Later Zhou changed it to Caozhou.

sentences.zh: 統縣九，戶十四萬九百四十八。
濟陰後魏置沛郡，後齊廢。又開皇六年分置黃縣，十八年改為蒙澤，大業初廢入焉。外黃後齊廢成安縣入。又開皇十八年置首城縣，大業初廢入焉。濟陽成武后齊置永昌郡。開皇初郡廢，十六年置戴州。大業初州廢。冤句乘氏定陶單父後魏曰離狐，置北濟陰郡。後齊郡縣並廢。開皇六年更置，名單父。金鄉開皇十六年分置昌邑縣，大業初併入。襄城郡東魏置北荊州，後周改曰和州。

translations.literal: Jiyin had Pei Commandery established by Later Wei, which Later Qi abolished. In Kaihuang year six Huang County was separately established; in year eighteen it was changed to Mengze, and at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Jiyin. Waihuang had Cheng'an County abolished into it by Later Qi. In Kaihuang year eighteen Shoucheng County was also established, and at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Waihuang. Jiyang and Chengwu had Yongchang Commandery established by Later Qi. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished; in year sixteen Daizhou was established. At the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. Yuanju, Chengshi, Dingtao, and Shanfu: Shanfu was called Lihu under Later Wei, and Northern Jiyin Commandery was established there. Later Qi abolished both commandery and county. In Kaihuang year six it was established again and named Shanfu. Jinxiang had Changyi County separately established in Kaihuang year sixteen; at the beginning of Daye it was merged into Jinxiang. Xiangcheng Commandery had Northern Jingzhou established by Eastern Wei; Later Zhou changed it to Hezhou.

承休舊曰汝原，置汝北郡，後改曰汝陰郡。後周郡廢。大業初改縣曰承休，置襄城郡。有黃水。梁舊置汝北郡，後齊廢。有濫泉。郟城舊曰龍山。東魏置順陽郡及南陽郡、南陽縣。開皇初改龍山曰汝南，三年二郡並廢。十八年改汝南曰輔城，南陽曰期城。大業初改輔城曰郟城，廢期城入焉。有關官，有大留山。陽翟東魏置陽翟郡，開皇初郡廢。有釣台。有九山祠。汝源汝南有後魏汝南郡及符壘縣，並後齊廢。魯後魏置荊州，尋廢，立魯陽郡，後置魯州。開皇初郡廢，大業初州廢。有關官。有和山、大義山。犨城舊曰雉陽。開皇十八年改曰湛水，大業初改名焉。又有後周置武山郡，開皇初廢。後魏置南陽縣、河山縣，大業初並廢入焉。有應山。潁川郡舊置潁州，東魏改曰鄭州，後周改曰許州。

translations.literal: Chengxiu was formerly called Ruyuan; Rubei Commandery was established there and later changed to Ruyin Commandery. Later Zhou abolished the commandery. At the beginning of Daye the county was changed to Chengxiu, and Xiangcheng Commandery was established. It had the Huang River. Liang formerly had Rubei Commandery, which Later Qi abolished. It had Lan Spring. Jiacheng was formerly called Longshan. Eastern Wei established Shunyang Commandery, Nanyang Commandery, and Nanyang County. At the beginning of Kaihuang, Longshan was changed to Runan; in year three both commanderies were abolished. In year eighteen Runan was changed to Fucheng and Nanyang to Qicheng. At the beginning of Daye Fucheng was changed to Jiacheng, and Qicheng was abolished into it. It had barrier offices and Daliu Mountain. Yangdi had Yangdi Commandery established by Eastern Wei, which was abolished at the beginning of Kaihuang. It had Diaotai and the Shrine of Nine Mountains. Ruyuan and Runan had Later Wei's Runan Commandery and Fulei County, both abolished by Later Qi. Lu had Jingzhou established by Later Wei; it was soon abolished, and Luyang Commandery was set up, after which Luzhou was established. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. It had barrier offices. It had He Mountain and Dayi Mountain. Choucheng was formerly called Zhiyang. In Kaihuang year eighteen it was changed to Zhanshui, and at the beginning of Daye its name was changed. It also had Wushan Commandery established by Later Zhou, which was abolished at the beginning of Kaihuang. Later Wei established Nanyang County and Heshan County, and at the beginning of Daye both were abolished into it. It had Ying Mountain. Yingchuan Commandery formerly had Yingzhou established there; Eastern Wei changed it to Zhengzhou, and Later Zhou changed it to Xuzhou.

潁川舊曰長社，置穎川郡，後齊廢潁陰縣入，開皇初廢郡改縣焉。又東魏置黃台縣，大業初廢入焉，置郡。襄城舊置襄城郡，後周置汝州。開皇初郡廢，大業初州廢。有溵水。汝墳後齊置漢廣郡，尋廢，有首山。葉後齊置襄州。後周廢襄州，置南襄城郡。開皇初郡廢。又東魏置定南郡，後周廢為定南縣。大業初省入。北舞舊置定陵郡，開皇初廢。有百尺溝。郾城開皇初置，十六年置道州，大業初州廢。又後魏置潁川郡，後齊改為臨潁郡，開皇初郡廢。又有邵陵縣，大業初廢。有溵水。繁昌臨潁尉氏後齊廢，開皇六年複。長葛開皇六年置。許昌㶏強開皇十六年置，曰陶城，大業初改焉。扶溝鄢陵東魏置許昌郡，後齊廢縣。開皇初郡廢，七年複鄢陵縣。十六年置洧州，大業初州廢。又開皇十六年置蔡陂縣，至是省入焉。汝南郡後魏置豫州，東魏置行台。

translations.literal: Yingchuan was formerly called Changshe, where Yingchuan Commandery was established. Later Qi abolished Yingyin County into it; at the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished and changed to a county. Eastern Wei also established Huangtai County, which at the beginning of Daye was abolished into it, and the commandery was established. Xiangcheng formerly had Xiangcheng Commandery; Later Zhou established Ruzhou. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. It had the Yin River. Rufen had Hanguang Commandery established by Later Qi, which was soon abolished. It had Shou Mountain. Ye had Xiangzhou established by Later Qi. Later Zhou abolished Xiangzhou and established Southern Xiangcheng Commandery. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. Eastern Wei also established Dingnan Commandery; Later Zhou abolished it and made it Dingnan County. At the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Ye. Beiwu formerly had Dingling Commandery, which was abolished at the beginning of Kaihuang. It had Baichi Ditch. Yancheng was established at the beginning of Kaihuang; in year sixteen Daozhou was established, and at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. Later Wei also established Yingchuan Commandery; Later Qi changed it to Linying Commandery, and at the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. It also had Shaoling County, which was abolished at the beginning of Daye. It had the Yin River. Fanchang, Linying, and Weishi were abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year six. Changge was established in Kaihuang year six. Xuchang and Zhuoqiang were established in Kaihuang year sixteen; Zhuoqiang was called Taocheng, and at the beginning of Daye its name was changed. Fugou and Yanling: Eastern Wei established Xuchang Commandery, and Later Qi abolished the county. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and in year seven Yanling County was restored. In year sixteen Weizhou was established, and at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. Also in Kaihuang year sixteen Caipi County was established, and by this time it was abolished into Yanling. Runan Commandery had Yuzhou established by Later Wei, and Eastern Wei established a branch secretariat there.

汝陽舊曰上蔡，置汝南郡。開皇初郡廢。大業初置郡，改縣曰汝陽，並廢保城縣入焉。有鴻郤陂。城陽舊廢，梁置，又有義興縣。後魏置城陽郡，梁置楚州，東魏置西楚州，後齊曰永州。開皇九年，廢入純州。十八年改義興為純義。大業初州縣並廢入焉。又梁置伍城郡，後齊廢。有十丈山、大木山。真陽舊置郢州。東魏廢州，置義陽郡。後齊廢郡入保城縣。開皇十一年廢縣。十六年置縣，曰真丘。大業初改曰真陽。又有白狗縣，梁置淮州。後齊廢州，以置齊興郡，郡尋廢。開皇初，改縣曰淮川，至是亦省入焉。又有後魏安陽縣，後廢。有汶水。新息後魏置東豫州。梁改曰西豫州。又改曰淮州。東魏複曰東豫州，後周改曰息州，大業初州廢。又後魏置汝南郡，開皇初郡廢。又梁置滇州，尋廢。又梁置北光城郡，東魏廢，又有北新息縣，後齊廢。褒信宋改曰包信。大業初改復舊焉。又梁置梁安郡，開皇初廢。又有長陵郡，後齊廢為縣。大業初又省縣焉。上蔡後魏置，曰臨汝。後齊廢。開皇中置，曰武津。大業初改名焉。平輿舊廢，大業初改新蔡置焉。有葛陂。新蔡齊置北新蔡郡，魏曰新蔡郡，東魏置蔡州。後齊廢州置廣寧郡。開皇初郡廢。十六年置舒州及舒縣、廣寧縣。仁壽元年改廣寧曰汝北。大業初州廢，改汝北曰新蔡。又後齊置永康縣，後改名曰澺水，至是及舒縣並廢入焉。朗山舊曰安昌，置初安郡。廢，十八年縣改名焉。又梁置除州，後魏廢，又齊置荊州，尋廢。後周又置威州，後又廢。吳房故曰遂甯，後齊省綏義縣入焉。大業初改曰吳房。西平後魏置襄城郡，後齊改郡曰文城，開皇初郡廢。又有故武陽縣，十八年改曰吳房，大業初省。又有故洧州、灊州，並後齊置，開皇初皆廢。淮陽郡開皇十六年置陳州。

translations.literal: Ruyang was formerly called Shangcai, where Runan Commandery was established. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. At the beginning of Daye the commandery was established, the county was changed to Ruyang, and Baocheng County was abolished into it. It had Hongxi Dyke. Chengyang had long been abolished; Liang established it, and it also had Yixing County. Later Wei established Chengyang Commandery; Liang established Chuzhou; Eastern Wei established Western Chuzhou; Later Qi called it Yongzhou. In Kaihuang year nine it was abolished into Chunzhou. In year eighteen Yixing was changed to Chunyi. At the beginning of Daye both province and county were abolished into Ruyang. Liang also established Wucheng Commandery, which Later Qi abolished. It had Shizhang Mountain and Damu Mountain. Zhenyang formerly had Yingzhou established. Eastern Wei abolished the province and established Yiyang Commandery. Later Qi abolished the commandery into Baocheng County. In Kaihuang year eleven the county was abolished. In year sixteen the county was established and called Zhenqiu. At the beginning of Daye it was changed to Zhenyang. It also had Baigou County; Liang established Huaizhou there. Later Qi abolished the province and used it to establish Qixing Commandery, which was soon abolished. At the beginning of Kaihuang the county was changed to Huaichuan, and by this time it too was abolished into Zhenyang. It also had Anyang County of Later Wei, later abolished. It had the Wen River. Xinxí had Eastern Yuzhou established by Later Wei. Liang changed it to Western Yuzhou and again changed it to Huaizhou. Eastern Wei restored the name Eastern Yuzhou; Later Zhou changed it to Xizhou; at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. Later Wei also established Runan Commandery, which was abolished at the beginning of Kaihuang. Liang also established Dianzhou, soon abolished. Liang also established Northern Guangcheng Commandery, which Eastern Wei abolished; it also had Northern Xinxí County, which Later Qi abolished. Baoxin was changed by Song to Baoxin with the alternate spelling, and at the beginning of Daye it was restored to the old name. Liang also established Liang'an Commandery, which was abolished at the beginning of Kaihuang. It also had Changling Commandery, which Later Qi abolished and made a county. At the beginning of Daye that county too was abolished. Shangcai was established by Later Wei and called Linru. Later Qi abolished it. During Kaihuang it was established and called Wujin. At the beginning of Daye its name was changed. Pingyu had long been abolished; at the beginning of Daye Xincai was changed and established there. It had Ge Dyke. Xincai had Northern Xincai Commandery established by Qi; Wei called it Xincai Commandery; Eastern Wei established Caizhou. Later Qi abolished the province and established Guangning Commandery. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. In year sixteen Shuzhou, Shu County, and Guangning County were established. In Renshou year one Guangning was changed to Rubei. At the beginning of Daye the province was abolished, and Rubei was changed to Xincai. Later Qi also established Yongkang County, later renamed Yishui; by this time it and Shu County were both abolished into Xincai. Langshan was formerly called Anchang, where Chu'an Commandery was established. It was abolished, and in year eighteen the county's name was changed. Liang also established Chuzhou, which Later Wei abolished; Qi also established Jingzhou, soon abolished. Later Zhou again established Weizhou, which was later also abolished. Wufang was formerly called Suining; Later Qi abolished Suiyi County into it. At the beginning of Daye it was changed to Wufang. Xiping had Xiangcheng Commandery established by Later Wei; Later Qi changed the commandery to Wencheng, and at the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. It also had former Wuyang County, which in year eighteen was changed to Wufang and at the beginning of Daye was abolished. It also had the former Weizhou and Qianzhou, both established by Later Qi and both abolished at the beginning of Kaihuang. Huaiyang Commandery had Chenzhou established in Kaihuang year sixteen.

sentences.zh: 宛丘後魏曰項，置陳郡。開皇初縣改名宛丘，尋廢郡，後析置臨蔡縣。大業初置淮陽郡，並臨蔡縣入焉。又後魏置南陽郡，東魏廢。西華舊曰長平，開皇十八年改曰鴻溝。大業初改焉。有舊長平縣，後齊廢。溵水開皇十六年置，又有後魏汝陽郡及縣，後齊郡廢，大業初縣廢。撫樂開皇十六年置。有渦水。太康舊曰陽夏，並置淮陽郡。開皇初郡廢，七年更名太康。有窪水。鹿邑舊曰武平，開皇十八年改名焉。項城東魏置揚州及丹陽郡、秣陵縣，梁改曰殷州，東魏又改曰北揚州，後齊改曰信州，後周改曰陳州。開皇初改秣陵為項縣。十六年分置沈州，大業初州廢，又有項城郡，開皇初分立陳郡，三年並廢。南頓舊置南頓郡。後齊廢郡及平鄉縣入，改曰和城。大業初又改為南頓。鄲開皇六年置。鮦陽後齊廢，開皇十一年複。又東魏置財州，後齊廢，以置包信縣。開皇初廢。汝陰郡舊置潁州。

translations.literal: Wanqiu was called Xiang under Later Wei, and Chen Commandery was established there. At the beginning of Kaihuang the county was renamed Wanqiu, and soon the commandery was abolished; afterward Lincai County was divided off and established. At the beginning of Daye, Huaiyang Commandery was established and Lincai County was merged into it. Later Wei also established Nanyang Commandery, which Eastern Wei abolished. Xihua was formerly called Changping. In Kaihuang year eighteen it was changed to Honggou, and at the beginning of Daye it was changed again. It had the former Changping County, which Later Qi abolished. Yinshui was established in Kaihuang year sixteen; it also had Later Wei's Ruyang Commandery and county. Later Qi abolished the commandery, and at the beginning of Daye the county was abolished. Fule was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. It had the Guo River. Taikang was formerly called Yangxia, where Huaiyang Commandery was also established. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished; in year seven the name was changed to Taikang. It had Wa River. Luyi was formerly called Wuping; in Kaihuang year eighteen its name was changed. Xiangcheng had Yangzhou, Danyang Commandery, and Moling County established by Eastern Wei. Liang changed it to Yinzhou; Eastern Wei again changed it to Northern Yangzhou; Later Qi changed it to Xinzhou; Later Zhou changed it to Chenzhou. At the beginning of Kaihuang, Moling was changed to Xiang County. In year sixteen Shenzhou was separately established; at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. It also had Xiangcheng Commandery; at the beginning of Kaihuang Chen Commandery was divided off and established, and in year three both were abolished. Nandun formerly had Nandun Commandery. Later Qi abolished the commandery and Pingxiang County into it and changed it to Hecheng. At the beginning of Daye it was again changed to Nandun. Dan was established in Kaihuang year six. Tongyang was abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year eleven. Eastern Wei also established Caizhou, which Later Qi abolished and used to establish Baoxin County. At the beginning of Kaihuang it was abolished. Ruyin Commandery formerly had Yingzhou established there.

sentences.zh: 上洛舊置上洛郡，開皇初郡廢，大業初複置。有秦嶺山、熊耳山、洛水、丹水。商洛有關官。洛南舊曰拒陽，置拒陽郡。開皇初郡廢，縣改名焉。有玄扈山、陽虛山。豐陽後周置，開皇初並南陽縣入。有洵水、甲水。上津舊置北上洛郡，梁改為南洛州，西魏又改為上州，後周並漫川、開化二縣入，大業初廢州。有天柱山、詔及山、女思山。弘農郡大業三年置。

translations.literal: Shangluo formerly had Shangluo Commandery established; at the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and at the beginning of Daye it was restored. sentences.zh: 南鄉舊置南鄉郡，後周並龍泉、湖裡、白亭三縣入。又有左南鄉縣，並置左鄉郡。西魏改郡為秀山，改縣為安山。後周秀山郡廢。開皇初南鄉郡廢。大業初置淅陽郡，並安山縣入焉。有石墨山。內鄉舊曰西淅陽郡，西魏改為內鄉。後周廢，並淅川、石人二縣入焉。有淅水。丹水舊置丹川郡。後周郡廢，並茅城、倉陵、許昌三縣入。有胡保山。武當舊置武當郡。又僑置始平郡，後改為齊興郡。梁置興州，後周改為豐州。開皇初二郡並廢，改為均州。大業初州廢。有石階山、武當山。均陽梁置。安福梁置，曰廣福，並為郡。開皇初郡廢，仁壽初改焉。鄖鄉有防山。南陽郡舊置荊州。

translations.literal: Nanxiang formerly had Nanxiang Commandery established; Later Zhou merged Longquan, Huli, and Baiting counties into it. It also had Zuo Nanxiang County, and Zuoxiang Commandery was established there. Western Wei changed the commandery to Xiushan and the county to Anshan. Later Zhou abolished Xiushan Commandery. At the beginning of Kaihuang, Nanxiang Commandery was abolished. At the beginning of Daye, Xiyang Commandery was established, and Anshan County was merged into it. It had Shimo Mountain. Neixiang was formerly called Western Xiyang Commandery; Western Wei changed it to Neixiang. Later Zhou abolished it and merged Xichuan and Shiren counties into it. It had the Xi River. Danshui formerly had Danchuan Commandery established. Later Zhou abolished the commandery and merged Maocheng, Cangling, and Xuchang counties into it. It had Hubao Mountain. Wudang formerly had Wudang Commandery established. Shaping Commandery was also established there in exile and later changed to Qixing Commandery. Liang established Xingzhou, and Later Zhou changed it to Fengzhou. At the beginning of Kaihuang the two commanderies were both abolished and changed to Junzhou. At the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. It had Shijie Mountain and Wudang Mountain. Junyang was established by Liang. Anfu was established by Liang and called Guangfu, and a commandery was also established there. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and at the beginning of Renshou the name was changed. Yunxiang had Fang Mountain. Nanyang Commandery formerly had Jingzhou established there.

sentences.zh: 鄖鄉南陽郡南陽郡舊置荊州。

translations.literal: Yunxiang. Nanyang Commandery: Nanyang Commandery formerly had Jingzhou established.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yunxiang. Nanyang Commandery, Nanyang Commandery had formerly had Jingzhou established.

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaihuang it was changed to Dengzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Kaihuang era, it was changed to Dengzhou

sentences.zh: 統縣八，戶七萬七千五百二十。

translations.idiomatic: The commandery governed 8 counties with a registered population of 77,520 households.

sentences.zh: 穰帶郡。有白水。新野舊曰棘陽，置新野郡。又有漢廣郡，西魏改為黃岡郡。又有南棘陽縣，改為百寧縣。後周二郡並廢，並南棘縣入焉。開皇初更名新野。南陽舊曰上陌，置南陽郡。後周並宛縣入，更名上宛。開皇初郡廢，又改為南陽。課陽舊曰涅陽，開皇初改焉。有課水、涅水。順陽舊置順陽郡。西魏析置鄭縣，尋改為清鄉。後周又並順陽入清鄉。開皇初又改為順陽。冠軍菊潭舊曰酈，開皇初改焉。有東弘農郡，西魏改為武關，至是廢入。有梅溪、湍水。新城西魏改為臨湍，開皇初複名焉。有朝水。淯陽郡西魏置蒙州。

translations.literal: Rang carried a commandery. It had Baishui. Xinye was formerly called Jiyang, where Xinye Commandery was established. It also had Hanguang Commandery, which Western Wei changed to Huanggang Commandery. It also had Southern Jiyang County, changed to Baining County. Later Zhou abolished both commanderies and merged Southern Jiyang County into it. At the beginning of Kaihuang it was renamed Xinye. Nanyang was formerly called Shangmo, where Nanyang Commandery was established. Later Zhou merged Wan County into it and renamed it Shangwan. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and it was again changed to Nanyang. Keyang was formerly called Nieyang; at the beginning of Kaihuang it was changed. It had the Ke River and Nie River. Shunyang formerly had Shunyang Commandery established. Western Wei divided off and established Zheng County, soon changing it to Qingxiang. Later Zhou also merged Shunyang into Qingxiang. At the beginning of Kaihuang it was again changed to Shunyang. Guanjun and Jutan: Jutan was formerly called Li; at the beginning of Kaihuang it was changed. It had Eastern Hongnong Commandery, which Western Wei changed to Wuguan; by this time it was abolished into Jutan. It had Mei Creek and the Tuan River. Xincheng was changed by Western Wei to Lintuan; at the beginning of Kaihuang its old name was restored. It had the Chao River. Yuyang Commandery had Mengzhou established by Western Wei.

sentences.zh: 新城淯陽郡淯陽郡西魏置蒙州。

translations.literal: Xincheng. Yuyang Commandery: Yuyang Commandery—in Western Wei, Mengzhou was established.
translations.idiomatic: Xincheng. Yuyang Commandery. Yuyang Commandery. in Western Wei, Mengzhou was established.

translations.literal: During Renshou it was renamed Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During Renshou it was renamed Yuzhou, as noted in the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 統縣三，戶一萬七千九百。

translations.idiomatic: The commandery governed 3 counties with a registered population of 17,900 households.

sentences.zh: 武川帶郡。有雉衡山。有淯水、紵水、灃水。向城西魏置，又立雉陽郡。開皇初郡廢。方城西魏置，及置襄邑郡。開皇初廢。東魏又置建城郡及建城縣，後齊郡縣並廢。又有業縣，開皇末改為灃水，大業併入。有西唐山。淮安郡後魏置東荊州，西魏改為淮州。

translations.literal: Wuchuan carried a commandery. It had Zhiheng Mountain. It had the Yu River, Zhu River, and Feng River. Xiangcheng was established by Western Wei, which also set up Zhiyang Commandery. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. Fangcheng was established by Western Wei, which also established Xiangyi Commandery. At the beginning of Kaihuang it was abolished. Eastern Wei also established Jiancheng Commandery and Jiancheng County; Later Qi abolished both commandery and county. It also had Ye County, which at the end of Kaihuang was changed to Fengshui and in Daye was merged into it. It had Xitang Mountain. Huai'an Commandery had Eastern Jingzhou established by Later Wei; Western Wei changed it to Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 方城淮安郡淮安郡後魏置東荊州，西魏改為淮州。

translations.literal: Fangcheng. Huai'an Commandery: Huai'an Commandery—in Later Wei, Eastern Jingzhou was established; Western Wei changed it to Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Fangcheng. Huai'an Commandery. Huai'an Commandery. in Later Wei, Eastern Jingzhou was established; Western Wei changed it to Huaizhou.

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Kaihuang it was again changed to Xianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: During Kaihuang year fifth, it was again changed to Xianzhou

sentences.zh: 統縣七，戶四萬六千八百四十。

translations.idiomatic: The commandery governed 7 counties with a registered population of 46,840 households.

sentences.zh: 比陽帶郡。後魏曰陽平，開皇七年改為饒良，大業初又改焉。又有後魏城陽縣，置殷州、城陽郡。開皇初郡並廢，其縣尋省。又有昭越縣，大業初改為同光，尋廢。又有東南陽郡，西魏改為南郭郡，後周廢。又有比陽故縣，置西郢州。西魏改為鴻州，後周廢為真昌郡。開皇初郡廢，大業初縣廢。平氏舊置漢廣郡，開皇初郡廢。有淮水。真昌舊曰北平，開皇九年改焉。顯岡舊置舞陰郡，開皇初郡廢。臨舞東魏置，及置期城郡。開皇初郡廢。又有東舞陽縣，開皇十八年改為昆水，大業初廢。慈丘後魏曰江夏，並置江夏郡。開皇初郡廢，更置慈丘於其北境。後魏有鄭州、潘州、溱州及襄城、周康二郡，上蔡、青山、震山三縣，並開皇初廢。有比水。桐柏梁置，曰淮安，並立華州，又立上川郡。西魏改州為淮州，後改為純州，尋廢。開皇初郡廢，更名縣曰桐柏。又梁置西義陽郡，西魏置淮陽郡及輔州，後周州郡並廢，又置淮南縣。開皇末改為油水，大業初廢。又有大義郡，後周置，開皇初廢。有桐柏山。

translations.literal: Biyang carried a commandery. Under Later Wei it was called Yangping; in Kaihuang year seven it was changed to Raoliang, and at the beginning of Daye it was changed again. It also had Chengyang County of Later Wei, where Yinzhou and Chengyang Commandery were established. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commanderies were all abolished, and the county was soon abolished. It also had Zhaoyue County, which at the beginning of Daye was changed to Tongguang and soon abolished. It also had Eastern Nanyang Commandery, which Western Wei changed to Nanguo Commandery and Later Zhou abolished. It also had old Biyang County, where Western Yingzhou was established. Western Wei changed it to Hongzhou, and Later Zhou abolished it and made it Zhenchang Commandery. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and at the beginning of Daye the county was abolished. Pingshi formerly had Hanguang Commandery established; at the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. It had the Huai River. Zhenchang was formerly called Beiping; in Kaihuang year nine it was changed. Xiangang formerly had Wuyin Commandery established; at the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. Linwu was established by Eastern Wei, which also established Qicheng Commandery. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. It also had Eastern Wuyang County, which in Kaihuang year eighteen was changed to Kunshui and at the beginning of Daye was abolished. Ciqiu was called Jiangxia under Later Wei, and Jiangxia Commandery was also established there. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and Ciqiu was newly established on its northern border. Later Wei had Zhengzhou, Panzhou, Qinzhou, Xiangcheng and Zhoukang commanderies, and Shangcai, Qingshan, and Zhenshan counties; all were abolished at the beginning of Kaihuang. It had the Bi River. Tongbai was established by Liang and called Huai'an; Huazhou was also set up, and Shangchuan Commandery was established. Western Wei changed the province to Huaizhou, and later changed it to Chunzhou, which was soon abolished. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and the county was renamed Tongbai. Liang also established Western Yiyang Commandery; Western Wei established Huaiyang Commandery and Fuzhou; Later Zhou abolished both province and commandery and also established Huainan County. At the end of Kaihuang it was changed to Youshui, and at the beginning of Daye it was abolished. It also had Dayi Commandery, established by Later Zhou and abolished at the beginning of Kaihuang. It had Tongbai Mountain.

sentences.zh: 豫州于《禹貢》為荊州之地。

translations.literal: In the Tribute of Yu, Yu Province was the territory of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: According to the "Tribute of Yu", Yu Province corresponded to the lands of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 其在天官，自氐五度至尾九度，為大火，於辰在卯，宋之分野，屬豫州。

translations.literal: In the celestial offices, from five degrees of Di to nine degrees of Wei is the Great Fire asterism; in the earthly branches it corresponds to mao; it is the allotted region of Song and belongs to Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: By the celestial divisions, from five degrees of Di to nine degrees of Wei marks the Great Fire; in the earthly branches it corresponds to mao; this was the Song allotment, part of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 自柳九度至張十六度，為鶉火，於辰在午，周之分野，屬三河，則河南。

translations.literal: From nine degrees of Liu to sixteen degrees of Zhang is the Quail Fire asterism; in the earthly branches it corresponds to wu; it is the allotted region of Zhou, belonging to the Three Rivers—that is, Henan.
translations.idiomatic: From nine degrees of Liu to sixteen degrees of Zhang is the Quail Fire asterism; in the earthly branches it corresponds to wu; it is the allotted region of Zhou, belonging to the Three Rivers—that is, Henan, as noted in the geography treatise.

translations.literal: The star station of Huai is also within the domain of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: The Huai star station likewise fell within Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 豫之言舒也，言稟平和之氣，性理安舒也。

translations.literal: Yu means "ease"; it signifies receiving the spirit of balance and harmony, with a disposition and nature that are calm and at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Yu means "ease"; it signifies receiving the spirit of balance and harmony, with a disposition and nature that are calm and at ease, as noted in the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 洛陽得土之中，賦貢所均，故周公作洛，此焉攸在。

translations.literal: Luoyang occupies the center of the land; tribute and levies were apportioned from it—thus when the Duke of Zhou built Luo, it was established here.
translations.idiomatic: Luoyang occupies the center of the land; tribute and levies were apportioned from it—thus when the Duke of Zhou built Luo, it was established here, as noted in the geography treatise.

translations.literal: Its customs esteem merchants and trade; cleverness and artifice have become the norm.
translations.idiomatic: Local custom esteem merchants and trade; cleverness and artifice have become the norm.

sentences.zh: 故《漢志》雲「周人之失，巧偽趨利，賤義貴財」，此亦自古然矣。

translations.literal: Therefore the Han Treatise says, "The fault of the people of Zhou was clever deceit and pursuit of profit, holding righteousness cheap and wealth dear"—this has been so from antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason, the Han Treatise says, "The fault of the people of Zhou was clever deceit and pursuit of profit, holding righteousness cheap and wealth dear"—this has been so from antiquity.

sentences.zh: 滎陽古之鄭地，梁郡梁孝故都，邪僻傲蕩，舊傳其俗。

translations.literal: Xingyang was the ancient land of Zheng; Liang Commandery was the former capital of King Xiao of Liang—wayward, arrogant, and dissolute; such were its customs by old report.
translations.idiomatic: Xingyang was the ancient land of Zheng; Liang Commandery was the former capital of King Xiao of Liang—wayward, arrogant, and dissolute; such were its customs by old report, as noted in the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 今則好尚稼穡，重于禮文，其風皆變于古。

translations.literal: Now they prefer farming and hold ritual and learning in high regard; their ways have all changed from antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: By the present day, they prefer farming and hold ritual and learning in high regard; their ways have all changed from antiquity.

sentences.zh: 譙郡、濟陰、襄城、潁川、汝南、淮陽、汝陰，其風頗同。

translations.literal: Qiao, Jiyin, Xiangcheng, Yingchuan, Runan, Huaiyang, and Ruyin commanderies share much the same customs.
translations.idiomatic: Qiao, Jiyin, Xiangcheng, Yingchuan, Runan, Huaiyang, and Ruyin commanderies share much the same customs, as noted in the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 南陽古帝鄉，搢紳所出，自三方鼎立，地處邊疆，戎馬所萃，失其舊俗。

translations.literal: Nanyang was the ancient homeland of emperors and the source of gentry officials; since the tripartite division of the realm it stood on the frontier, where war-horses gathered, and lost its old customs.
translations.idiomatic: Nanyang was the ancient homeland of emperors and the source of gentry officials; since the tripartite division of the realm it stood on the frontier, where war-horses gathered, and lost its old customs, as noted in the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 上洛、弘農，本與三輔同俗。

translations.literal: Shangluo and Hongnong originally shared the customs of the Three Adjuncts.
translations.idiomatic: Shangluo and Hongnong originally shared the customs of the Three Adjuncts, as noted in the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 自漢高發巴蜀之人，定三秦，遷巴之渠率七姓，居於商洛之地，由是風俗不改其壤。

translations.literal: Since Emperor Gaozu of Han dispatched the people of Ba and Shu to settle the Three Qin, relocating seven clan leaders of Ba to dwell in the Shangluo region, the customs there have not changed from their original soil.
translations.idiomatic: Since Emperor Gaozu of Han dispatched the people of Ba and Shu to settle the Three Qin, relocating seven clan leaders of Ba to dwell in the Shangluo region, the customs there have not changed from their original soil, as noted in the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 其人自巴來者，風俗猶同巴郡。

translations.literal: Those among the people who came from Ba still have customs much like Ba Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Those among the people who came from Ba still have customs much like Ba Commandery, as noted in the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 淅陽、淯陽、亦頗同其俗雲。

translations.literal: Xiyang and Yuyang also largely share those customs.
translations.idiomatic: Xiyang and Yuyang also largely share those customs, as noted in the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 兗州東郡。東郡開皇九年置杞州，十六年改為滑州，大業二年為兗州。

translations.literal: Yan Province, Dong Commandery. In Kaihuang year nine, Qizhou was established in Dong Commandery; in year sixteen it was changed to Huazhou, and in Daye year two it became Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Province, Dong Commandery. In Kaihuang year nine, Qizhou was established in Dong Commandery; in year sixteen it was changed to Huazhou, and in Daye year two it became Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 統縣九，戶十二萬一千九百五。

translations.idiomatic: The commandery governed 9 counties with a registered population of 121,905 households.

sentences.zh: 白馬舊置東郡，後齊並涼城縣入焉。大業初複置郡。靈昌開皇十六年置。衛南開皇十六年置，大業初廢西濮陽入焉。又有後魏平昌、長樂二縣，後齊並廢。濮陽開皇十六年分置昆吾縣，大業初入焉。封丘後齊廢，開皇十六年複。匡城後齊曰長垣，開皇十六年改焉。胙城舊曰東燕，開皇十八年改焉。韋城開皇六年置，十六年分置長垣縣，大業初省入焉。離狐東平郡後周置魯州，尋廢。開皇十年置鄆州。

translations.literal: Baima formerly had Eastern Commandery established; Later Qi merged Liangcheng County into it. At the beginning of Daye the commandery was restored. Lingchang was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. Weinan was established in Kaihuang year sixteen; at the beginning of Daye Western Puyang was abolished into it. It also had Later Wei's Pingchang and Changle counties, both abolished by Later Qi. Puyang had Kunwu County divided off and established in Kaihuang year sixteen; at the beginning of Daye it was merged into Puyang. Fengqiu was abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year sixteen. Kuangcheng was called Changyuan by Later Qi; in Kaihuang year sixteen it was changed. Zuocheng was formerly called Eastern Yan; in Kaihuang year eighteen it was changed. Weicheng was established in Kaihuang year six; in year sixteen Changyuan County was divided off and established; at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Weicheng. Lihu and Dongping Commandery: Later Zhou established Luzhou, which was soon abolished. In Kaihuang year ten Yunzhou was established.

sentences.zh: 鄆城後周置，曰清澤，又置高平郡。開皇初郡廢，改縣曰萬安。十八年改曰鄆城。大業初置郡，並廩丘入焉。鄄城舊置濮陽郡，開皇初郡廢，十六年置濮州，大業初州廢。有關官。須昌開皇十六年置。有梁山。宿城後齊曰須昌，開皇十六年改焉。舊置東平郡，後齊並廢。雷澤舊曰城陽，後齊廢。開皇十六年置，曰雷澤，又分置臨濮縣。大業初併入焉。有曆山、雷澤。钜野舊廢，開皇十六年複，又置乘丘縣，大業初廢入焉。濟北郡舊置濟州。

translations.literal: Yuncheng was established by Later Zhou and called Qingze; Gaoping Commandery was also established there. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished and the county was changed to Wan'an. In year eighteen it was changed to Yuncheng. At the beginning of Daye the commandery was established, and Linqiu was merged into it. Juancheng formerly had Puyang Commandery established. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished; in year sixteen Puzhou was established; at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. It had barrier offices. Xuchang was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. It had Liang Mountain. Sucheng was called Xuchang by Later Qi; in Kaihuang year sixteen it was changed. It formerly had Dongping Commandery established; Later Qi abolished both. Leize was formerly called Chengyang and was abolished by Later Qi. In Kaihuang year sixteen it was established and called Leize, and Linpu County was also divided off and established. At the beginning of Daye it was merged into Leize. It had Li Mountain and Leize Marsh. Juye had long been abolished and was restored in Kaihuang year sixteen; Chengqiu County was also established, and at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Juye. Jibei Commandery formerly had Jizhou established there.

sentences.zh: 統縣九，戶十萬五千六百六十。

translations.idiomatic: The commandery governed 9 counties with a registered population of 105,660 households.

sentences.zh: 盧舊置郡，開皇初廢。六年分置濟北縣，大業初省入焉，尋置郡。有關官。有成回倉，有魚山、遊仙山。范後齊廢，開皇十六年置。陽穀開皇十六年置。東阿有浮山、𡽳山、狼水。平陰開皇十四年置，曰榆山，大業初改焉。長清開皇十四年置。又有東太原郡，後齊廢。濟北開皇十四年置，曰時平，大業初改焉。壽張肥城宋置濟北郡，後齊廢。後周置肥城郡，尋廢，又複。開皇初又廢。武陽郡後周魏置魏州。

translations.literal: Lu formerly had a commandery established, which was abolished at the beginning of Kaihuang. In year six Jibei County was divided off and established; at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Lu, and soon a commandery was established. It had barrier offices. It had Chenghui Granary, Yu Mountain, and Youxian Mountain. Fan was abolished by Later Qi and established in Kaihuang year sixteen. Yanggu was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. Dong'e had Fu Mountain, Xian Mountain, and the Lang River. Pingyin was established in Kaihuang year fourteen and called Yushan; at the beginning of Daye it was changed. Changqing was established in Kaihuang year fourteen. It also had Eastern Taiyuan Commandery, abolished by Later Qi. Jibei was established in Kaihuang year fourteen and called Shiping; at the beginning of Daye it was changed. Shouzhang and Feicheng: Song established Jibei Commandery, which Later Qi abolished. Later Zhou established Feicheng Commandery, soon abolished it, and later restored it. At the beginning of Kaihuang it was again abolished. Wuyang Commandery: Later Zhou and Wei established Weizhou.

translations.idiomatic: The commandery governed 14 counties with a registered population of 213,035 households.

sentences.zh: 貴鄉東魏置。又有平邑縣，後齊廢，開皇十六年又置。大業初置武陽郡，並省平邑縣入焉。有愜山。元城後齊廢。開皇六年複，又置馬陵縣，大業初廢入焉。有沙麓山。繁水舊曰昌樂，置昌樂郡。東魏郡廢，後周又置。舊有魏城縣，後齊廢。開皇初廢郡，六年置縣，曰繁水。大業初廢昌樂縣入焉。魏後齊廢，開皇六年複。十六年析置漳陰縣，大業初省入焉。莘舊曰陽平，後齊改曰樂平。開皇六年複曰陽平，八年改曰清邑，十六年置莘州。大業初州廢，改縣名莘，又廢莘亭縣入焉。後周置武陽郡焉，開皇初廢。頓丘後齊省，開皇六年置。又有舊陰安縣，後齊廢。觀城舊曰衛國，開皇六年改。臨黃後魏置，後齊省，開皇六年複，十六年分置河上縣，大業初省入焉。武陽後齊省，後周置。武水開皇十六年置。館陶舊置毛州，大業初州廢。又有舊陽平郡，開皇初廢。堂邑開皇六年置。冠氏開皇六年置。聊城舊置南冀州及平原郡，未幾，州廢。開皇初郡廢。十六年置博州，大業初州廢。渤海郡開皇六年置棣州，大業二年為滄州。

translations.literal: Guixiang was established by Eastern Wei. It also had Pingyi County, abolished by Later Qi and again established in Kaihuang year sixteen. At the beginning of Daye, Wuyang Commandery was established and Pingyi County was abolished into it. It had Qie Mountain. Yuancheng was abolished by Later Qi. In Kaihuang year six it was restored, and Maling County was also established; at the beginning of Daye Maling was abolished into it. It had Shalu Mountain. Fanshui was formerly called Changle, where Changle Commandery was established. Eastern Wei abolished the commandery, and Later Zhou established it again. It formerly had Weicheng County, abolished by Later Qi. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and in year six the county was established and called Fanshui. At the beginning of Daye, Changle County was abolished into it. Wei was abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year six. In year sixteen Zhangyin County was divided off and established; at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Wei. Shen was formerly called Yangping; Later Qi changed it to Leping. In Kaihuang year six it was again called Yangping, in year eight changed to Qingyi, and in year sixteen Shenzhou was established. At the beginning of Daye the province was abolished, the county was renamed Shen, and Shenting County was also abolished into it. Later Zhou established Wuyang Commandery there, which was abolished at the beginning of Kaihuang. Dunqiu was abolished by Later Qi and established in Kaihuang year six. It also had old Yin'an County, abolished by Later Qi. Guancheng was formerly called Weiguo; in Kaihuang year six it was changed. Linhuang was established by Later Wei and abolished by Later Qi; in Kaihuang year six it was restored, and in year sixteen Heshang County was divided off and established; at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Linhuang. Wuyang was abolished by Later Qi and established by Later Zhou. Wushui was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. Guantao formerly had Maozhou established; at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. It also had old Yangping Commandery, abolished at the beginning of Kaihuang. Tangyi was established in Kaihuang year six. Guanshi was established in Kaihuang year six. Liaocheng formerly had Southern Jizhou and Pingyuan Commandery established; before long the province was abolished. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. In year sixteen Bozhou was established, and at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. Bohai Commandery had Dizhou established in Kaihuang year six, which in Daye year two became Cangzhou.

sentences.zh: 統縣十，戶十二萬二千九百九。

translations.idiomatic: The commandery governed 10 counties with a registered population of 122,299 households.

sentences.zh: 陽信帶郡。樂陵舊置樂陵郡，開皇初郡廢。十六年分置鬲津縣，大業初廢入焉。滳河開皇十六置。又有後魏濕沃縣，後齊廢。有關官。厭次後齊廢，開皇十六年複。蒲台開皇十六年置。饒安舊置滄州、浮陽郡，開皇初郡廢，大業初州廢。無棣開皇六年置。鹽山舊曰高成。開皇十六年又置浮水縣。十八年改高成曰鹽山。大業初省浮水入焉。有鹽山、峽山。南皮清池舊曰浮陽，開皇十八年改。平原郡開皇九年置德州。

translations.literal: Yangxin carried a commandery. Leling formerly had Leling Commandery established; at the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. In year sixteen Gejin County was divided off and established, and at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Leling. Shanghe was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. It also had Shiwo County of Later Wei, abolished by Later Qi. It had barrier offices. Yanci was abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year sixteen. Putai was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. Rao'an formerly had Cangzhou and Fuyang Commandery established; at the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. Wudi was established in Kaihuang year six. Yanshan was formerly called Gaocheng. In Kaihuang year sixteen Fushui County was also established. In year eighteen Gaocheng was changed to Yanshan. At the beginning of Daye, Fushui was abolished into it. It had Yan Mountain and Xia Mountain. Nanpi and Qingchi: Qingchi was formerly called Fuyang, and in Kaihuang year eighteen it was changed. Pingyuan Commandery had Dezhou established in Kaihuang year nine.

translations.idiomatic: Qingchi. Pingyuan Commandery. Pingyuan Commandery. in the ninth year of Kaihuang, Dezhou was established.

sentences.zh: 統縣九，戶十三萬五千八百二十二。

translations.idiomatic: The commandery governed 9 counties with a registered population of 135,822 households.

sentences.zh: 安樂舊置平原郡，開皇初郡廢，大業初複，又開官皇十六年置繹幕縣，至是廢入焉。又有後魏鬲縣，後齊廢，有關官。平原後齊並鄃縣入焉。有關官。又後魏置東青州，置未久而為。將陵開皇十六年置。平昌後魏置東安郡，後齊廢，並以重平縣入焉。般後齊省，開皇十六年複。長河舊曰廣川。後齊省，開皇六年複置，仁壽初改名焉。弓高舊廢，開皇十六年置。東光舊置渤海郡，開皇初郡廢。九年置觀州，大業初州廢，又並安陵入焉。有天胎山。胡蘇舊廢，開皇十六年置。

translations.literal: Anle formerly had Pingyuan Commandery established; at the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and at the beginning of Daye it was restored. Also, in Kaihuang year sixteen Yimu County was established, and by this time it was abolished into Anle. It also had Ge County of Later Wei, abolished by Later Qi, and had barrier offices. Pingyuan had Shu County merged into it by Later Qi. It had barrier offices. Later Wei also established Eastern Qingzhou, which before long was abolished. Jiangling was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. Pingchang had Dong'an Commandery established by Later Wei; Later Qi abolished it and also merged Chongping County into it. Ban was abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year sixteen. Changhe was formerly called Guangchuan. Later Qi abolished it; in Kaihuang year six it was restored, and at the beginning of Renshou its name was changed. Gonggao had long been abolished and was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. Dongguang formerly had Bohai Commandery established; at the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. In year nine Guanzhou was established; at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished, and Anling was also merged into it. It had Tiantai Mountain. Husu had long been abolished and was established in Kaihuang year sixteen.

sentences.zh: 兗州于《禹貢》為濟、河之地。

translations.literal: In the Tribute of Yu, Yan Province was the territory of Ji and He.
translations.idiomatic: According to the "Tribute of Yu", Yan Province corresponded to the lands of Ji and He.

sentences.zh: 其於天官，自軫十二度至氐四度，為壽星，于辰在辰，鄭之分野。

translations.literal: In the celestial offices, from twelve degrees of Zhen to four degrees of Di is the Longevity Star asterism; in the earthly branches it corresponds to chen; it is the allotted region of Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the celestial offices, from twelve degrees of Zhen to four degrees of Di is the Longevity Star asterism; in the earthly branches it corresponds to chen; it is the allotted region of Zheng, as noted in the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 兗州蓋取沇水為名，亦曰兗，兗之為言端也，言陽精端端，故其氣纖殺也。

translations.literal: Yan Province takes its name from the Yan River; it is also called Yan—yan meaning "upright"; it signifies the yang essence standing upright, hence its qi is fine and cutting.
translations.idiomatic: Yan Province takes its name from the Yan River; it is also called Yan—yan meaning "upright"; it signifies the yang essence standing upright, hence its qi is fine and cutting, as noted in the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 東郡、東平、濟北、武陽、平原等郡，得其地焉。

translations.literal: Dong, Dongping, Jibei, Wuyang, Pingyuan, and other commanderies obtained this territory.
translations.idiomatic: Dong, Dongping, Jibei, Wuyang, Pingyuan, and other commanderies obtained this territory, as noted in the geography treatise.

translations.literal: It also combined the junction of Zou, Lu, Qi, and Wei.
translations.idiomatic: It also combined the junction of Zou, Lu, Qi, and Wei, as noted in the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 舊傳太公唐叔之教，亦有周孔遺風。

translations.literal: By old report the teachings of Grand Duke and Duke of Tang survived, and traces of the Zhou and Confucian legacy remained.
translations.idiomatic: By old report the teachings of Grand Duke and Duke of Tang survived, and traces of the Zhou and Confucian legacy remained, as noted in the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 今此數郡，其人尚多好儒學，性質直懷義，有古之風烈矣。

translations.literal: Now among these several commanderies, the people largely still love Confucian learning; their nature is straightforward and they cherish righteousness—there remain the heroic manners of antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: By the present day, among these several commanderies, the people largely still love Confucian learning; their nature is straightforward and they cherish righteousness—there remain the heroic manners of antiquity.

sentences.zh: 冀州信都郡信都郡舊置冀州。

translations.literal: Ji Province, Xindu Commandery: Xindu Commandery formerly had Jizhou established.
translations.idiomatic: Under Ji Province, Xindu Commandery, Xindu Commandery had formerly had Jizhou established.

sentences.zh: 統縣十二，戶十六萬八千七百一十八。

translations.idiomatic: The commandery governed 12 counties with a registered population of 168,718 households.

sentences.zh: 長樂舊曰信都，帶長樂郡，後齊廢扶柳縣入焉。開皇初郡廢，分信都置長樂縣。十六年又分長樂置澤城縣。大業初廢信都及澤城入焉，置信都郡。堂陽舊縣，後齊廢，開皇十六年複。衡水開皇十六年置。棗強舊縣，後齊廢索蘆、廣川二縣入焉。武邑舊縣，後齊廢。開皇六年置，並得後齊觀津縣地。十六年分武強置昌亭縣，大業初廢入焉。武強舊置武邑郡，後齊郡廢，又廢武遂縣入焉。南宮舊縣，後齊廢，開皇六年複。斌強鹿城舊曰鄡，後齊改曰安國。開皇六年改為安定，十八年改。開皇十六年又置晏城，大業初廢入。下博蓚舊曰脩，開皇五年改。十六年分置觀津縣，大業初廢。阜城清河郡後周置貝州。

translations.literal: Changle was formerly called Xindu and carried Changle Commandery; Later Qi abolished Fuliu County into it. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and Changle County was divided off from Xindu and established. In year sixteen Zecheng County was also divided off from Changle and established. At the beginning of Daye, Xindu and Zecheng were abolished into it, and Xindu Commandery was established. Tangyang was an old county; Later Qi abolished it, and in Kaihuang year sixteen it was restored. Hengshui was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. Zaoqiang was an old county; Later Qi abolished Suolu and Guangchuan counties into it. Wuyi was an old county and was abolished by Later Qi. In Kaihuang year six it was established and also received the territory of Later Qi's Guanjin County. In year sixteen Changting County was divided off from Wuqiang and established; at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Wuyi. Wuqiang formerly had Wuyi Commandery established; Later Qi abolished the commandery and also abolished Wusui County into it. Nangong was an old county, abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year six. Binqiang and Lucheng: Lucheng was formerly called Xiao; Later Qi changed it to Anguo. In Kaihuang year six it was changed to Anding, and in year eighteen changed again. In Kaihuang year sixteen Yancheng was also established, and at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Lucheng. Xiabo and Tiao: Tiao was formerly called Xiu; in Kaihuang year five it was changed. In year sixteen Guanjin County was divided off and established, and at the beginning of Daye it was abolished. Fucheng and Qinghe Commandery: Later Zhou established Beizhou.

translations.literal: Fucheng. Qinghe Commandery: Qinghe Commandery—Later Zhou established Beizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Fucheng. Qinghe Commandery. Qinghe Commandery. Later Zhou established Beizhou.

sentences.zh: 統縣十四，戶三十萬千六五百四十四。

translations.idiomatic: The commandery governed 14 counties with a registered population of 306,544 households.

sentences.zh: 清河舊曰武城，置清河郡。開皇初郡廢，改名焉，仍別置武城縣。十六年置夏津縣，大業初廢入，置清河郡。清陽舊曰清河縣，後齊省貝丘入焉，改為貝丘，開皇六年改為清陽。又有後魏候城縣，後齊省以入武城，亦入焉。武城舊曰上城。開皇初改武城為清河縣，于此置武城。曆亭開皇十六年分武城置焉。漳南開皇六年置，曰東陽，十八年改為漳南。有後魏故索盧城，後齊以入棗強，至是入。鄃舊廢，開皇十六年置。臨清後齊廢，開皇六年年複。又十六年置沙丘縣，大業初廢入焉。清泉後齊廢千童縣入。開皇十六年置貝丘縣，大業二年廢入。清平開皇六年置，曰貝丘，十六年改曰清平。高唐後魏置南清河郡，後齊郡廢。經城後齊廢，開皇六年置，十六年分置府城縣，大業初省入焉。宗城舊曰廣宗，仁壽元年改。博平開皇六年置靈縣，大業初省入。茌平後齊廢，開皇初複。魏郡後魏置相州，東魏改曰司州牧。

translations.literal: Qinghe was formerly called Wucheng, where Qinghe Commandery was established. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished and the name was changed, while Wucheng County was separately established. In year sixteen Xiajin County was established; at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Qinghe, and Qinghe Commandery was established. Qingyang was formerly called Qinghe County; Later Qi abolished Beiqiu into it and changed it to Beiqiu, and in Kaihuang year six it was changed to Qingyang. It also had Houcheng County of Later Wei, which Later Qi abolished into Wucheng, and it too was merged into Qingyang. Wucheng was formerly called Shangcheng. At the beginning of Kaihuang, Wucheng was changed to Qinghe County, and Wucheng was established here. Liting was divided off from Wucheng and established in Kaihuang year sixteen. Zhangnan was established in Kaihuang year six and called Dongyang; in year eighteen it was changed to Zhangnan. It had old Suolu City of Later Wei, which Later Qi merged into Zaoqiang and by this time was merged into Zhangnan. Shu had long been abolished and was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. Linqing was abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year six. In year sixteen Shaqiu County was also established, and at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Linqing. Qingquan had Qiantong County abolished into it by Later Qi. In Kaihuang year sixteen Beiqiu County was established, and in Daye year two it was abolished into Qingquan. Qingping was established in Kaihuang year six and called Beiqiu; in year sixteen it was changed to Qingping. Gaotang had Southern Qinghe Commandery established by Later Wei, and Later Qi abolished the commandery. Jingcheng was abolished by Later Qi and established in Kaihuang year six; in year sixteen Fucheng County was divided off and established; at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Jingcheng. Zongcheng was formerly called Guangzong; in Renshou year one the name was changed. Boping was established in Kaihuang year six as Ling County, and at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Boping. Chiping was abolished by Later Qi and restored at the beginning of Kaihuang. Wei Commandery had Xiangzhou established by Later Wei; Eastern Wei changed it to Sizhou Governorate.

sentences.zh: 茌平魏郡魏郡後魏置相州，東魏改曰司州牧。

translations.literal: Chiping. Wei Commandery: Wei Commandery—Later Wei established Xiangzhou; Eastern Wei changed it to Sizhou Inspectorate.
translations.idiomatic: Chiping. Wei Commandery. Wei Commandery. Later Wei established Xiangzhou; Eastern Wei changed it to Sizhou Inspectorate.

sentences.zh: 後周又改曰相州，置六府。

translations.literal: Later Zhou again changed it to Xiangzhou and established six offices.
translations.idiomatic: Later Zhou again changed it to Xiangzhou and established six offices, as noted in the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 宣政初府移洛，以置總管府，未幾，府廢。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Xuanzheng the offices moved to Luo; a grand administrative office was established, but before long the office was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Xuanzheng the offices moved to Luo; a grand administrative office was established, but before long the office was abolished, as noted in the geography treatise.

sentences.zh: 統縣十一，戶十二萬二百二十七。

translations.idiomatic: The commandery governed 11 counties with a registered population of 120,227 households.

sentences.zh: 安陽周大象初，置相州及魏郡，因改名鄴，開皇初郡廢，十年複，名安陽，分置相縣，鄴還復舊。大業初廢相入焉，置魏郡有韓陵山。鄴東魏都。後周平齊，置相州。大象初縣隨州徙安陽，此改為靈芝縣。開皇十年又改焉。臨漳東魏置。成安後齊置。靈泉後周置。有龍山。堯城開皇十年置，名長樂，十八年改焉。洹水後周置。滏陽後周置。開皇十年置慈州，大業初州廢。臨水有慈石山、鼓山、滏山。林慮後魏置林慮郡，後齊郡廢，後又置。開皇初郡廢，又分置淇陽縣。十六年置岩州。大業初州廢，又廢淇陽入焉。有林慮谼、仙人台、洹水。臨淇東魏置，尋廢，開皇十六年複。有淇水。汲郡東魏置義州，後周為衛州。

translations.literal: Anyang: at the beginning of Zhou's Daxiang, Xiangzhou and Wei Commandery were established, and because of this the name was changed to Ye. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished; in year ten it was restored and named Anyang, Xiang County was divided off and established, and Ye returned to its old name. At the beginning of Daye, Xiang was abolished into Anyang, and Wei Commandery was established. It had Hanling Mountain. Ye was the capital of Eastern Wei. After Later Zhou pacified Qi, it established Xiangzhou. At the beginning of Daxiang the county moved with the province to Anyang, and this place was changed to Lingzhi County. In Kaihuang year ten it was changed again. Linzhang was established by Eastern Wei. Cheng'an was established by Later Qi. Lingquan was established by Later Zhou. It had Long Mountain. Yaocheng was established in Kaihuang year ten and named Changle; in year eighteen it was changed. Huanshui was established by Later Zhou. Fuyang was established by Later Zhou. In Kaihuang year ten Cizhou was established, and at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. Linshui had Cishi Mountain, Gu Mountain, and Fu Mountain. Linlü had Linlü Commandery established by Later Wei; Later Qi abolished the commandery and later established it again. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and Qiyang County was separately established. In year sixteen Yanzhou was established. At the beginning of Daye the province was abolished, and Qiyang was also abolished into Linlü. It had Linlü Valley, Immortal Terrace, and the Huan River. Linqi was established by Eastern Wei and soon abolished; in Kaihuang year sixteen it was restored. It had the Qi River. Ji Commandery had Yizhou established by Eastern Wei; Later Zhou made it Weizhou.

translations.literal: Linqi. Ji Commandery: Ji Commandery—Eastern Wei established Yizhou; Later Zhou made it Weizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Linqi. Ji Commandery. Ji Commandery. Eastern Wei established Yizhou; Later Zhou made it Weizhou.

sentences.zh: 統縣八，戶十一萬一千七百二十一。

translations.idiomatic: The commandery governed 8 counties with a registered population of 111,721 households.

sentences.zh: 衛舊曰朝歌，置汲郡。後周又分置修武郡。開皇初郡並廢，十六年又置清淇縣。大業初置汲郡，改朝歌縣曰衛，廢清淇入焉。有朝陽山、同山。有紂朝歌城、比干墓。汲東魏僑置七郡十八縣。後齊省，以置伍城郡，後周廢為伍城縣，開皇六年改焉。隋興開皇六年置。後析置陽源縣，大業初併入焉。有倉岩山。黎陽後魏置黎陽郡，後置黎州。開皇初州郡並廢。十六年又置黎州，大業初，罷。有倉。有關官。有大伾山、枉人山。內黃舊廢，開皇六年置。十六年分置繁陽縣，大業初廢入。湯陰舊廢，開皇六年又置。有博望岡。臨河開皇六年置。澶水開皇十六年置。河內郡舊置懷州。

translations.literal: Wei was formerly called Chaoge, where Ji Commandery was established. Later Zhou also divided off and established Xiuwu Commandery. At the beginning of Kaihuang both commanderies were abolished, and in year sixteen Qingqi County was again established. At the beginning of Daye, Ji Commandery was established, Chaoge County was changed to Wei, and Qingqi was abolished into it. It had Chaoyang Mountain and Tong Mountain. It had King Zhou's Chaoge City and Bi Gan's tomb. Ji had seven commanderies and eighteen counties established there in exile by Eastern Wei. Later Qi abolished them and used the territory to establish Wucheng Commandery; Later Zhou abolished it and made it Wucheng County, and in Kaihuang year six the name was changed. Suixing was established in Kaihuang year six. Later Yangyuan County was divided off and established, and at the beginning of Daye it was merged into Suixing. It had Cangyan Mountain. Liyang had Liyang Commandery established by Later Wei, and later Lizhou was established. At the beginning of Kaihuang both province and commandery were abolished. In year sixteen Lizhou was again established, and at the beginning of Daye it was abolished. It had granaries and barrier offices. It had Dapi Mountain and Wangren Mountain. Neihuang had long been abolished and was established in Kaihuang year six. In year sixteen Fanyang County was divided off and established, and at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Neihuang. Tangyin had long been abolished and was again established in Kaihuang year six. It had Bowang Ridge. Linhe was established in Kaihuang year six. Chanshui was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. Henei Commandery formerly had Huaizhou established there.

translations.literal: Chanshui. Henei Commandery: Henei Commandery formerly had Huaizhou established.
translations.idiomatic: Under Chanshui. Henei Commandery, Henei Commandery had formerly had Huaizhou established.

sentences.zh: 統縣十，戶十三萬三千六百六。

translations.idiomatic: The commandery governed 10 counties with a registered population of 133,606 households.

sentences.zh: 河內舊曰野王，置河內郡。開皇初郡廢，十六年縣改焉。有軹縣，大業初廢入，尋置郡。有大行，有丹水。有絺城。溫舊廢，開皇十六年置。古溫城。濟源開皇十六年置。舊有沁水縣，後齊廢入。有孔山、母山。有濟水、濝水、古原城。河陽，舊廢，開皇十六年置。有盟津。有古河陽城治。安昌舊曰州縣，置武德郡。開皇初郡廢，十八年縣改為邢丘。大業初改名安昌，又廢懷縣入焉。舊有平高縣，後齊廢。王屋舊曰長平，後周改焉，後又置懷州。及平齊，廢州置王屋郡。開皇初郡廢。有王屋山、齊子嶺。有軹關。獲嘉後周置修武郡，開皇初郡廢。十六年置殷州，大業初州廢。新鄉開皇初年置。有關官。舊有獲嘉縣，後齊廢。修武后魏置修武，後齊併入焉。開皇十六年析置武陟，大業初併入焉。又有東魏廣寧郡，後周廢。共城舊曰共，後齊廢。開皇六年複署，曰共城。有共山、白鹿山。長平郡舊曰建州。

translations.literal: Henei was formerly called Yewang, where Henei Commandery was established. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished, and in year sixteen the county was changed. It had Zhi County, which at the beginning of Daye was abolished into Henei; soon the commandery was established. It had Daxing, the Dan River, and Zhi City. Wen had long been abolished and was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. It had old Wen City. Jiyuan was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. It formerly had Qinshui County, which Later Qi abolished into it. It had Kong Mountain, Mu Mountain, the Ji River, the Qi River, and old Yuan City. Heyang had long been abolished and was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. It had Meng Ford and the seat of old Heyang City. Anchang was formerly called Zhou County, where Wude Commandery was established. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished; in year eighteen the county was changed to Xingqiu. At the beginning of Daye the name was changed to Anchang, and Huai County was also abolished into it. It formerly had Pinggao County, abolished by Later Qi. Wangwu was formerly called Changping; Later Zhou changed it, and later also established Huaizhou. When Qi was pacified, the province was abolished and Wangwu Commandery was established. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. It had Wangwu Mountain, Qizi Ridge, and Zhi Pass. Huojia had Xiuwu Commandery established by Later Zhou; at the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. In year sixteen Yinzhou was established, and at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. Xinxiang was established at the beginning of Kaihuang. It had barrier offices. It formerly had Huojia County, abolished by Later Qi. Xiuwu was established by Later Wei, and Later Qi merged it into Huojia. In Kaihuang year sixteen Wuzhi was divided off and established, and at the beginning of Daye it was merged into Xiuwu. It also had Guangning Commandery of Eastern Wei, abolished by Later Zhou. Gongcheng was formerly called Gong and was abolished by Later Qi. In Kaihuang year six it was restored and called Gongcheng. It had Gong Mountain and Bailu Mountain. Changping Commandery was formerly called Jianzhou.

Wangwu was formerly called Changping; Later Zhou changed it, and later also established Huaizhou. When Qi was pacified, the province was abolished and Wangwu Commandery was established. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. It had Wangwu Mountain, Qizi Ridge, and Zhi Pass. Huojia had Xiuwu Commandery established by Later Zhou; at the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. In year sixteen Yinzhou was established, and at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. Xinxiang was established at the beginning of Kaihuang. It had barrier offices. It formerly had Huojia County, abolished by Later Qi. Xiuwu was established by Later Wei, and Later Qi merged it into Huojia. In Kaihuang year sixteen Wuzhi was divided off and established, and at the beginning of Daye it was merged into Xiuwu. It also had Guangning Commandery of Eastern Wei, abolished by Later Zhou. Gongcheng was formerly called Gong and was abolished by Later Qi. In Kaihuang year six it was restored and called Gongcheng. It had Gong Mountain and Bailu Mountain. Changping Commandery was formerly called Jianzhou.

sentences.zh: 共城長平郡長平郡舊曰建州。

translations.literal: Gongcheng. Changping Commandery: Changping Commandery was formerly called Jianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Gongcheng. Changping Commandery. Changping Commandery was formerly called Jianzhou.

translations.literal: At the beginning of Kaihuang it was changed to Zezhou.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Kaihuang era, it was changed to Zezhou

sentences.zh: 統縣六，戶五萬四千九百一十三。

translations.idiomatic: The commandery governed 6 counties with a registered population of 54,913 households.

sentences.zh: 丹川舊曰高都。後齊置長平、高都二郡，後周並為高平郡。開皇初郡廢，十八年改為丹川，大業初置長平郡。有太行山。沁水舊置廣寧郡。後齊郡廢，縣改為永寧。開皇十八年改焉。有輔山。端氏後魏置安平郡，開皇初郡廢。有巨峻山、秦川水。濩澤有嶕嶢山，濩澤山。高平舊曰平高，齊末改焉，又並玄氏縣入焉。有關官。陵川開皇十六年置。上黨郡後周置潞州。

translations.literal: Danchuan was formerly called Gaodu. Later Qi established Changping and Gaodu commanderies, and Later Zhou combined them as Gaoping Commandery. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished; in year eighteen the county was changed to Danchuan, and at the beginning of Daye Changping Commandery was established. It had Taihang Mountain. Qinshui formerly had Guangning Commandery established. Later Qi abolished the commandery, and the county was changed to Yongning. In Kaihuang year eighteen it was changed. It had Fu Mountain. Duanshi had Anping Commandery established by Later Wei, which was abolished at the beginning of Kaihuang. It had Jujun Mountain and the Qinchuan River. Huozhe had Jiaoyao Mountain and Huozhe Mountain. Gaoping was formerly called Pinggao; at the end of Qi it was changed, and Xuanshi County was also merged into it. It had barrier offices. Lingchuan was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. Shangdang Commandery had Luzhou established by Later Zhou.

sentences.zh: 陵川上黨郡上黨郡後周置潞州。

translations.literal: Lingchuan. Shangdang Commandery: Shangdang Commandery—Later Zhou established Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lingchuan. Shangdang Commandery. Shangdang Commandery. Later Zhou established Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 統縣十，戶十二萬五千五十七。

translations.idiomatic: The commandery governed 10 counties with a registered population of 125,057 households.

sentences.zh: 上黨舊置上黨郡，開皇初郡廢。有壺關縣。大業初複置郡，廢壺關入焉。有羊頭山、抱犢山。長子後齊廢。開皇九年置，曰寄氏縣。十八年改為長子。舊有屯留、樂陽二縣，後齊廢。有濁漳水、堯水。潞城開皇十六年置。有黃阜山。屯留後齊廢，開皇十六年複。襄垣舊置襄垣郡，後齊郡廢。後周置韓州，大業初州廢。有鹿臺山。黎城後魏以潞縣被誅遺人置，十八年改名黎城。有積布山、松門嶺。涉後魏廢，開皇十八年複。有崇山。鄉石勒置武鄉郡，後魏去武字。開皇初郡廢，十六年分置榆社縣，大業初廢。又有後魏南垣州，尋改豐州，後周廢。銅鞮有舊涅縣，後魏改為陽城。開皇十八年改為甲水，大業初省入。有銅鞮水。沁源後魏置縣及義寧郡，開皇初廢。十六年置沁州。又義寧縣十八年改為和川。大業初州廢，又廢和川縣入。河東郡後魏曰秦州，後周改曰蒲州。

translations.literal: Shangdang formerly had Shangdang Commandery established; at the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished. It had Huguan County. At the beginning of Daye the commandery was restored, and Huguan was abolished into it. It had Yangtou Mountain and Baodu Mountain. Zhangzi was abolished by Later Qi. In Kaihuang year nine it was established and called Jishi County; in year eighteen it was changed to Zhangzi. It formerly had Tunliu and Leyang counties, abolished by Later Qi. It had the Zhuozhang River and Yao River. Lucheng was established in Kaihuang year sixteen. It had Huangfu Mountain. Tunliu was abolished by Later Qi and restored in Kaihuang year sixteen. Xiangyuan formerly had Xiangyuan Commandery established; Later Qi abolished the commandery. Later Zhou established Hanzhou, and at the beginning of Daye the province was abolished. It had Lutai Mountain. Licheng was established by Later Wei using the surviving people of Lu County after its punishment; in year eighteen its name was changed to Licheng. It had Jibu Mountain and Songmen Ridge. She was abolished by Later Wei and restored in Kaihuang year eighteen. It had Chong Mountain. Xiang had Wuxiang Commandery established by Shi Le; Later Wei removed the character wu. At the beginning of Kaihuang the commandery was abolished; in year sixteen Yushe County was divided off and established, and at the beginning of Daye it was abolished. It also had Southern Yuanzhou of Later Wei, soon changed to Fengzhou and abolished by Later Zhou. Tongdi had old Nie County, which Later Wei changed to Yangcheng. In Kaihuang year eighteen it was changed to Jiashui, and at the beginning of Daye it was abolished into Tongdi. It had the Tongdi River. Qinyuan had a county and Yining Commandery established by Later Wei, both abolished at the beginning of Kaihuang. In year sixteen Qinzhou was established. Also, Yining County was changed to Hechuan in year eighteen. At the beginning of Daye the province was abolished, and Hechuan County was also abolished into Qinyuan. Hedong Commandery was called Qinzhou by Later Wei, and Later Zhou changed it to Puzhou.
